positive.name: gray2048-gradient-ans
positive.scope: Actual retained shared-input stream selected by the controlled decode benchmark; copied without regeneration.

negative.name: gray2048-predecessor-missing-empty-state
negative.scope: Retained predecessor output omits the empty global ANS initial/final state. Strict decoder rejection is required; not a valid positive comparison input.

corrections: Release-5 and ASan-5 each recorded one failure because the original positive test accidentally selected the 363-byte predecessor artifact instead of the actual 367-byte shared input. Production source is unchanged; both artifacts and failure reports remain retained.

Release-6 and ASan-6 each recorded one expectation failure: all serial/default/eight-worker outputs agreed, but the test incorrectly assumed 32768 from a separate generated constant-image test. The original benchmark PAM independently contains only 21845 (0x5555). Test and provenance now use that source-grounded value and payload hash; production code and both compressed artifacts are unchanged.
